description: Stage 4 and Stage 5 currently sync broken origin/main into an already-approved PR branch and withdraw consensus or dispatch the PR resolver to edit unrelated main modules out-of-scope when origin/main itself fails hygiene or unit checks.
goal: Implement the origin/main baseline guard helper in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/main_baseline_guard.py and wire it across apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/calibrate_target_sync.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/ci_failure_routing.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/ci_noise_rerun.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/consensus_withdrawal.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/loop.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/merged_head_gate.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/merged_head_routing.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/sync_points.py, registering any new public review exports in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/lazy_exports_review.py (`REVIEW_LAZY_EXPORTS`) and keeping every module within its line budget without EVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json: before syncing origin/main into an already-approved PR in Stage 4/5 or routing FIND-CI to a PR resolver, inspect origin/main's latest hygiene (and unit) check status; if origin/main itself is red on a check whose failing path was not touched by the PR diff, refuse to sync broken origin/main or withdraw existing consensus, and classify inherited origin/main baseline failures as blocked_on: 'main-baseline-failing' rather than dispatching the PR resolver to edit unrelated main files out-of-scope. Add unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_main_baseline_guard.py. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Syncing a temporarily red origin/main wastes dozens of CI runs and withdraws consensus on unrelated clean PRs.
acceptance_criteria: Before syncing `origin/main` into an already-approved PR in Stage 4/5 or routing `FIND-CI` to a PR resolver, Stage 4/5 inspects `origin/main`'s latest `hygiene` (and `unit`) check status; if `origin/main` itself is red on a check whose failing path was not touched by the PR diff, Stage 4/5 refuses to sync broken `origin/main` or withdraw existing consensus.

Inherited `origin/main` baseline failures are classified as `blocked_on: "main-baseline-failing"` rather than PR defects, refusing to dispatch the PR resolver to edit unrelated `main` files out-of-scope.
Unit tests in `apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_main_baseline_guard.py` prove the guard with `uv run pytest`, `uv run task lint` passes, and self-explaining code invariant holds.

The baseline guard in `flow/review/main_baseline_guard.py` is wired through `flow/calibrate_target_sync.py`, `flow/review/ci_failure_routing.py`, `flow/review/ci_noise_rerun.py`, `flow/review/consensus_withdrawal.py`, `flow/review/loop.py`, `flow/review/merged_head_gate.py`, `flow/review/merged_head_routing.py`, and `flow/review/sync_points.py`, with public review exports registered in `flow/lazy_exports_review.py`.

assumptions.statement: GitHub check-run status and failing paths on origin/main (hygiene and unit) can be inspected via existing flow GitHub helpers before target sync or FIND-CI routing.
All changes across the 11 declared scope files stay within existing module_budgets.json line caps without modifying module_budgets.json.

assumption_validation.method: Verify against flow/github/ci.py and test_main_baseline_guard.py unit tests.
Run uv run pytest and uv run task lint including module budget checks.

assumption_risk.response: fail-fast in unit tests and Stage 4 review
split helpers cleanly within main_baseline_guard.py and verify budgets in hygiene lint
